# The supply ledger

The ledger lives on a shelf in the store shed, under the oilcloth. Each entry gives the date, the crate count and the initials of the boatman who signed for it. The last entry before the storm is in Tomas's hand, and it reads only: _Tea, two tins. Paraffin, six. Matches, none._

Under it, in Ada's careful round writing, is the first line she has ever signed on the island: _Matches, none. Asked for by T. Vell. Will ask again on the spring tide._
